beats.say: You think the BCCI never loses? This IPL team played fourteen matches. Then the BCCI was ordered to pay it 538 crore. How?
lines: the IPL team that beat the BCCI

beats.say: Kochi Tuskers Kerala. Bought in 2010 for about 1,533 crore rupees.
2011 में बस एक season खेला। Six wins, eight losses.
beats.cap: 2011: they played just one season. Six wins, eight losses.

beats.say: Then a bank guarantee was late. The BCCI threw Kochi out, and cashed the old one: 153 crore.
lines: the next bank guarantee was late

beats.say: लेकिन Kochi ने हार नहीं मानी। 2015 में arbitration जीत गई।
beats.cap: But Kochi didn't give up. In 2015, it won the arbitration.
lines: arbitrator: the BCCI was wrong to end the contract

beats.say: June 2025. The Bombay High Court backed it. 538 crore. Over 38 crore for every match played.
lines: Bombay High Court upholds the award

beats.say: और twist? Deadline के बाद भी BCCI, Kochi के payments लेता रहा।
beats.cap: The twist? The BCCI kept accepting Kochi's payments after the deadline.

beats.say: Send this to the friend who says the BCCI never loses. The full story is on our YouTube channel, Behind The Hype.
lines: to the friend who says the BCCI never loses
Full story: YouTube, Behind The Hype
